mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite UNRATE declining for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (demand) rises while FEDFUNDS falls, indicating accommodative monetary policy supporting demand growth, this combination signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite GDPC1 increasing and FEDFUNDS falling for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals potential rate hikes, but strong growth expectations drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falling in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite CPIAUCSL falling in late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite INDPRO increasing for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO crosses above 105, indicating strong supply growth, this signals robust production and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite INDPRO crossing above 105.

mechanism_narrative: When both INDPRO (supply) and GDPC1 (demand) exceed 105 and 22,758.75 respectively, signaling robust growth in both sectors, this combination drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite INDPRO > 105 and GDPC1 > 22758.75 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery, a drop in UNRATE below 4.0% signals labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% in post-shock recovery regime
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% in post-shock recovery regime.
